method: Azure gpt-5, 3 independent action-specific votes per shot on a 5-frame chronological strip; intended action stated (not a blind identity test); majority required, plus manual sheet inspection and Blender per-frame geometry verification

covered_cart-open.observed: A blue corrugated cover over the cart lifts and swings backward: closed in frame 1, partially raised in frames 2–3, then fully upright/open behind the cart in frames 4–5, exposing the cart’s top/front.

dynamite-explode.observed: A red dynamite stick stands in the first two frames. In frame 3 an orange star-shaped blast appears where it was, expanding in frame 4. By frame 5 the stick is gone and small red/green fragments are scattered in a ring on the ground, with gray cloud-like spheres above.

dynamite-fire.observed: An orange glowing tip moves along the fuse toward the top of the dynamite while the fuse shortens. Gray smoke puffs are visible above and shift upward across frames.

fuse_bundle-fire.observed: A bright flame/spark with smoke starts at the lower fuse end and advances up the cord toward the three sticks. Behind it the rope turns black/charred. By frame 4–5 the glowing spark reaches the junction near the dynamite and flares there.

gold_pan-pour.observed: Frame 1: pan upright with nuggets inside. Frame 2: pan sharply tilts. Frame 3: several nuggets are seen spilling out midair from the tilted pan. Frame 4: nuggets reach the ground while the pan stays tilted. Frame 5: a nugget remains on the ground beneath the pan.

gold_shotgun-fire.observed: Shotgun stays centered. In frame 3 an orange muzzle flash appears at the barrel. In frames 4 and 5 a small yellow projectile is visible above the barrel and moves upward. Other small pieces near the gun remain mostly unchanged.

gold_shotgun-load.observed: Frame 1: shotgun closed. Frame 2: shotgun breaks open; a red shell appears near the breech. Frame 3: shell moves closer to the open barrel. Frame 4: shell is visibly seated in the right barrel. Frame 5: shotgun is closed again.

gold_vein-explode.observed: Intact gold-veined rock in frames 1–2; frame 3 shows a sudden orange explosion where it was; frame 4 the blast expands with rock and gold chunks flying; frame 5 shows gray smoke above and scattered gold and rock pieces on the ground.

gold_vein-open.observed: A gray block with two front plates separates: the plates swing outward and fall to the ground, revealing a yellow wavy stripe on the exposed face. The main cube stays intact; no new fracture propagates.

hand_drill-drill.observed: The crank wheel visibly rotates and wood shavings appear and accumulate on the block. The drill assembly also shifts sideways (frame 3) and then back. The hole looks similar throughout; the bit’s depth doesn’t clearly change.

magnifier-swing.observed: The magnifying glass changes orientation around its center; the handle moves from pointing down to left, then to right, and back down, with the shadow sweeping accordingly while the glass stays roughly in place.

perforated_cart-roll.observed: Cart shifts slightly right/back across frames; wheel spokes visibly rotate each frame; shadow moves with the cart.

rocket_arrow-fire.observed: Rocket starts on the ground. An orange flame appears and strengthens with gray smoke beneath. By frames 4–5 the rocket is clearly off the ground and higher, with a visible exhaust plume.
